features.name: Form of Dread
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you assume a dreadful form for 1 minute: Temporary Hit Points, immunity to the Frightened condition; once per turn, a hit frightens the target and deals extra Necrotic damage.

features.name: Grave Touched
features.desc: Your attacks and spells can deal Necrotic damage instead of their normal type; you don't need food, water, or air.

features.name: Necrotic Husk
features.desc: Resistance to Necrotic damage (Immunity while in Form of Dread); when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you explode with necrotic energy.

features.name: Spirit Projection
features.desc: As an action, you project your spirit: you move incorporeally, and your attacks and spells can originate from both your body and your spirit.
